📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Victor just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Vikram strikes the Scarred Buffering.
💥 The Scarred Buffering SNAPS! No warning. There never is.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vikram just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Alexis just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Liam just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Liam, Alexis and Otto met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Otto didn't come back. Liam, Alexis are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Liam taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Liam is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Liam just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Liam, Alexis, Hosam and Miguel met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 barely walked away. Liam, Alexis, Hosam, Miguel are hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."
🛡️ Miguel, Nina and Nikolai met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Miguel, Nina, Nikolai are hurt.
🛡️ Miguel and Nikolai met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Miguel, Nikolai are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
